items.q: In the CAUSES line at the foot of the page, the order of the entities after DKD is:
opts: CGN, then IN, then CTID, then ADPKD
IN, then CGN, then ADPKD, then CTID
CTID, then IN, then CGN, then ADPKD
ADPKD, then CTID, then IN, then CGN
items.exp: CAUSES: Diabetic Kidney Disease (DKD) > Chronic Glomerulonephritis (CGN) > Ischemic nephropathy (IN) > Chronic TubuloIntersticial Disease (CTID) > Adult polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD). (Book p805)

items.q: In the same CAUSES line, DKD carries the label m/c and ______.
items.exp: DKD: m/c worst prognosis; CGN: (and m/c). (Book p805)

items.q: All but one appear in the CAUSES ranking line. Which is the odd one out?
items.exp: The line lists DKD > CGN > IN > CTID > ADPKD; Alport syndrome is not on this line. (Book p805)
